---
title: Footnote in an annotation item
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '#footnote\['
          - 'quarto-annotation-item\("annotated-cell-1", 1'
        -
          - 'quarto-code-annotations:'
---

```{.python}
x = 1  # <1>
```

1. Assign x.[^1]

[^1]: The footnote text.
